description: One starter: a card in the starter picker that makes a new canvas, as one JSON file (M39). The built-ins live in Sources/NexusCanvas/Starters/; a .nexusstarter file holds one (M50), and a .nexusstarters pack holds several as {"starters": [...]}.

boundaries.description: Boundaries around outline topics' branches: groups, zones, networks and trust boundaries.

topics.description: Outline topics, by their text (the first in outline order).

collection.description: The starter picker's shelf (M50). Neither a category (For You) nor a Home shelf (a role's row).

details.description: More about outline topics, each found by its text (the first in outline order).

days.description: A scheduled task's length in days, from start; without start it's a milestone that many days out.

edge.description: The label on the edge into the topic: a data flow, a protocol, Yes or No.

markers.description: Marker ids, such as priority-1, flag-red or progress-50.

progress.description: A to-do's progress, in whole percent.

start.description: A scheduled task's first day, counted from the day the starter is used (0 is that day).

document.description: A whole one-canvas OpenNexus JSON document (a .nexusjson, its assets in base64), for a starter saved from a canvas (M50). It takes the place of outline.

id.description: Unique id, letters, digits and hyphens. Blank starters are generated as blank.<type>, so ids never start with blank.

kicker.description: Small capitals over the title, in English.

lanes.description: A swimlane's lanes, top to bottom, each with the outline topics in it. Other topics take their parent's lane, or the first.

topics.description: Outline topics, by their text (the first in outline order).

name.description: The card's title, in English (looked up in the string catalog).

note.description: The root topic's note, in Markdown: how to use the starter.

order.description: Position among the built-ins; Home's shelves keep this order.

outline.description: Topics, one per line: the root first, then each topic indented two spaces a level deeper than its parent. "Text >nodeType" sets a node type. A starter has an outline or a document.

relationships.description: Relationships between outline topics, found by their text (the first in outline order).

kind.description: A relationship kind, such as a sequence diagram's return message.

shelf.description: Home's template shelf for a role.

structure.description: The canvas's layout structure when it isn't the type's own, such as timeline.alternating.

summary.description: One line under the title, in English.

type.description: The canvas's diagram type (a canvas type id, such as mindmap or dfd).

title: OpenNexus starter
